db.title: Databases
db.description: Databases folder of the pipelines: a database missing from it is built (and saved to <output dir>/db). The folder can also be given as a tar archive of it (path or URL), that must hold all the needed databases.

basedir.description: Databases folder, as built by wf/db or the db/ folder of a previous run, or tar archive of it (path or URL)

archive.description: Name of the tar archive of the databases (<archive>.tar.gz)
